messages.content: "在一個物理實驗中，你被給予兩個電荷。第一個電荷的大小為5庫倫，第二個電荷的大小為10庫倫。這些電荷相距2公尺。你被要求計算這些電荷之間的電磁力。你進行了兩次實驗。第一次，電荷被放置在真空中，其介電常數為8.854 x 10^-12 F/m。第二次，電荷被放置在一個相對介電常數為5 x 10^-12 F/m的介質中。你能計算出兩種情況下電荷之間的電磁力嗎？"

function.name: electromagnetic_force
function.description: Calculate the electromagnetic force between two charges placed at a certain distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

charge1.description: The magnitude of the first charge in coulombs.

charge2.description: The magnitude of the second charge in coulombs.

distance.description: The distance between the two charges in meters.

medium_permittivity.description: The relative permittivity of the medium in which the charges are present. Default is 8.854 x 10^-12 F/m (vacuum permittivity). This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute electromagnetic force using Coulomb's law: F = k * q1 * q2 / r^2, where k = 1/(4π ε0) if we use vacuum permittivity. But the function expects medium_permittivity parameter. It says default is 8.854e-12 F/m (vacuum permittivity). So we can call the function twice with appropriate parameters.

But note: The user gave relative permittivity? They said "second time, the medium has relative permittivity 5 x 10^-12 F/m". Actually they wrote "相對介電常數為5 x 10^-12 F/m". That seems like absolute permittivity? Usually relative permittivity is dimensionless. But they gave units F/m. Might be confusion. We'll treat it as absolute permittivity value. So we pass medium_permittivity=5e-12.

Compute:

First case: q1=5 C, q2=10 C, distance=2 m, medium_permittivity=8.854e-12.

Second case: same but medium_permittivity=5e-12.
